newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy quarterly accounts after March 15 - Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Italy quarterly accounts after March 15 - Ciampi.

text.p: Italy's quarterly accounts will not be ready until after March 15, Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi told parliament on Wednesday.
"We cannot do it by the 15th," Ciampi said.

The quarterly accounts will be used to decide the size of the forthcoming mini-budget, to be unveiled before April 27, which Ciampi has said will include some 14 trillion lire of deficit cutting measures.
Cabinet secretary Enrico Micheli was earlier quoted as saying in the financial daily newspaper Il Sole 24 Ore that the accounts would not be ready until March 20.
